# SettingsManager

> **File:** `services/SettingsManager.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

The settings page's working copy of the config. Edits are applied live (in memory) as they're made; saveChanges() persists them, resetChanges() reloads from disk. Only the settings actually edited are applied and saved, onto the latest config, so changes made elsewhere meanwhile (a theme, a wallpaper, the bar editor) survive. Also keeps the page's own state (category, search), since the page is unloaded whenever the overlay closes.

### Properties

- `localConfig` (readonly alias)
- `savedConfig` (readonly alias)
- `isDirty` (readonly alias)
- `changedPaths` (readonly var): Key paths ("Appearance.font.size") that differ from the saved config; arrays count as one value
- `changedCount` (readonly int)
- `cursorThemes` (readonly var): Installed cursor themes (XCursor or hyprcursor), for the "cursorThemes" options; listed once, when this is first used
- `category` (string): The settings page's selected category and search text
- `query` (string)
- `collapsed` (var): Settings cards the user folded, by SchemaLayout group key; saved in state/settings.json so they stay folded across restarts
- `settingPaths` (readonly var): Every value the settings page shows, as { path, key, schema }, with key the dotted path.
- `showIfValue` (readonly var): A `/`-rooted `x-showIf` key's value (configValueAt)

### Signals

- `jumpRequested(string key, bool unfolded)`: The page scrolls to a card (by SchemaLayout group key), unfolding it first; `unfolded` says it had to, so the page waits for it to open

### Functions

- `openCategory(name)`: Opens the overlay's settings page on a category (its sidebar name)
- `openSection(key)`: Opens it on the category holding a config section ("Chat")
- `jumpTo(key)`
- `isCollapsed(key)`
- `setCollapsed(keys, value)`: `keys`: one group key or a list of them
- `isChanged(path)`
- `hasChangesUnder(prefix)`: Whether anything under a path prefix (e.g. a section key) has changed
- `loadConfig()`
- `ensureLoaded()`: Loads the draft unless it holds unsaved edits (the page is rebuilt whenever the overlay reopens)
- `setValue(path, value)`: Sets one value by path (e.g. ["Appearance", "shape", "radius"]) and applies it live.
- `setValues(entries)`: Sets several values ([{ path, value }]), applied live in one go
- `discard(paths)`: Puts the settings at these key paths back as saved (one card's Discard)
- `setDraftValue(path, value)`: Sets one value in the draft only (a text field being typed in), so it shows as unsaved; setValue applies it
- `schemaAt(path)`: The schema of the setting at a key path
- `optionsFor(fieldSchema)`: The choices for a string setting (`enum` or `x-options`), else null
- `suggestionsFor(fieldSchema)`: Values offered as chips beside a free-text setting (`x-suggestions`): it still takes anything typed
- `settingFor(key)`
- `parseValue(schema, text)`: Parses typed text for a setting: { value } or { error }
- `commitValue(key, value)`: Sets one setting and saves it straight away, leaving any unsaved edits on the page alone.
- `commitValues(values)`: Sets config values by dotted path ({ "Apps.terminal": "foot" }) and saves them at once; false if the result doesn't validate.
- `configValueAt(dottedPath)`: A value anywhere in the running config, by dotted path ("Workspaces.layout"): what an `x-showIf` key starting with `/` reads.
- `valueOf(key)`
- `saveChanges()`: Stays dirty if the save is rejected (invalid, or saves are blocked)
- `resetChanges()`
